 Weekly Recalls: Cadillac/Chevrolet, Dodge, Hyundai, Lincoln

 **CADILLAC/CHEVROLET** 
 LOSS OF BRAKING
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V717000 
 Manufacturer General Motors, LLC 
 Components SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 67380 
 Summary 
 General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023–2027 Cadillac LYRIQ, 2025–2026 model year Cadillac CELESTIQ, 2024–2027 Chevrolet Blazer EV, and 2026-2027 Cadillac VISTIQ vehicles. The brake system control module (BSCM) contains a software defect that may cause a loss of braking during certain driving conditions.
 Remedy 
 The BSCM software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262570900. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026.
 Click Here For NHTSA Documents 
 **DODGE** 
 TAIL LIGHTS MAY FAIL
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V701000 
 Manufacturer Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) 
 Components EXTERIOR LIGHTING 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 13330 
 Summary 
 Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Dodge Durango vehicles. The terminals in the tail light wiring harness may be damaged and cause the tail lights to fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment." 
 Remedy 
 Dealers will inspect and replace the tail light assemblies, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 3, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403 . Chrysler's number for this recall is A2D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 29, 2026. 
 Click Here For NHTSA Documents 
 **HYUNDAI** 
 AIR BAGS & SEAT PRETENSIONERS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A CRASH 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V728000 
 Manufacturer Hyundai Motor America 
 Components AIR BAGS 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 37901 
 Summary 
 Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.
 Remedy 
 Dealers will update the ACU software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 1, 2027. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 311. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2026.
 Click Here For NHTSA Documents 
 **LINCOLN** 
 LOSS OF DRIVE POWER FROM UNEXPECTED SHIFT TO NEUTRAL
 CRASH RISK 
 NHTSA ID Number: 26V688000 
 Manufacturer Ford Motor Company 
 Components POWER TRAIN 
 Potential Number of Units Affected: 11623 
 Summary 
 Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Nautilus Hybrid and 2027 Corsair Hybrid vehicles. The vehicle may unexpectedly shift into neutral while driving, due to corrosion in the transmission's park lock actuator circuit board. 
 Remedy 
 Dealers will replace the Integrated Park Module (IPM), free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 2, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332 . Ford's number for this recall is 26S75. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 26, 2026.
